annotations.comment: Where is this retry ledger on device? Think we need to specify

Should this be project settings? Or global .acstack settings, then project-specific overrides inside project folders inside that global folder? Thought here is then we can we don't have to git ignore AC stack and we could probably have it work across work trees regardless of where that work tree is on device. I kind of like that design better it feels more elegant to me. Do you agree?
